canonicalEventIdentity.keyFormula: keccak256(abi.encode(chainId, contractAddress, blockNumber, blockHash, transactionHash, logIndex))
canonicalEventIdentity.removalRule: a removal is lawful only when the removed key equals the key recomputed from the canonical coordinates of the orphaned log
canonicalEventIdentity.replayRule: re-running ingestion from genesis over canonical logs must reproduce the identical key set

cursorSemantics.composition: cursor encodes the last returned order key and the claim/release scope it was issued under
cursorSemantics.validation: a cursor is rejected with CursorScopeMismatch if its claimId or releaseId differs from the request scope
cursorSemantics.immutability: cursors are not invalidated by concurrent appends; new evidence greater than the cursor order key is returned on subsequent pages

pageLimits.invalidLimitError: InvalidPageLimit(uint256 requested, uint256 min, uint256 max)

duplicatePrevention.rule: each evidence item is identified by CID and must appear at most once in a full traversal
duplicatePrevention.idempotentAppend: appending an already-present CID is a canonical no-op and does not alter order or cursors

finalizedClaimBehavior.rule: once a claim is finalized, its historical evidence pages are immutable and must remain readable with the same order and cursors

concurrentAppendSafety.mechanism: keyset cursor pagination over the canonical order key; no numeric offsets are used
concurrentAppendSafety.appendBetweenPages: newly appended evidence with an order key greater than the cursor key is included in later pages; evidence at or before the cursor key is never repeated

anchor.authority: read-only; no settlement, treasury, or outcome authority is exposed or granted

consumerResponsibilities: ingest only after confirmationDepth ancestor blocks are observed
treat ProtocolFinalized windows as the only irreversible trigger
absorb reorgs up to maxReorgDepth via lawful removals; resynchronize from genesis beyond it
replay from genesis and compare the key set against the stored projection
record chainId and anchor address at ingestion; never reuse guarantees across deployments
paginate evidence using keyset cursors bound to claimId, releaseId, and order key; never use numeric offsets
validate page limits against minLimit and maxLimit and surface canonical errors
treat finalized claims as append-frozen while preserving historical reads

feeOnTransfer.reason: recipient balance delta can be lower than the requested amount; accounting must not assume exact amount delivered
feeOnTransfer.enforcement: pre-flight balance-delta probe must observe exact delta equal to the requested amount or the transfer is rejected before funds are accepted

rebasing.reason: holder balances change without transfer events, invalidating stored balance assumptions and delta accounting
rebasing.enforcement: reject any token whose totalSupply or account balance observed before and after a no-op interval differs

erc777Hooks.reason: transfer hooks can re-enter, block, or alter state during a transfer
erc777Hooks.enforcement: reject tokens that expose ERC777-style transfer hooks or any callback invocation during transfer/approval

falseReturn.reason: a transfer/approval that returns false must not be treated as successful
falseReturn.enforcement: require return data of exactly 32 bytes equal to true; any false or non-canonical return is a reverting failure

missingReturn.reason: non-standard tokens return no data, which cannot be distinguished from a failure without extra probing
missingReturn.enforcement: reject tokens that do not return exactly 32 bytes of true on transfer/approval

blacklisting.reason: administrative blocklists can freeze funds or block transfers after acceptance, breaking settlement guarantees
blacklisting.enforcement: reject tokens that expose administrative freeze/blacklist authority over holder transfers

decimalsExtremes.reason: decimals below 0 or above 18 overflow formatting and fixed-point math assumptions
decimalsExtremes.enforcement: reject tokens whose decimals() is not in [0, 18] or whose scaling factor overflows uint256 arithmetic

accountingRules: accounting uses observed balance deltas for all accepted assets
any transfer whose observed recipient delta differs from the requested amount is rejected and reverted
any transfer whose observed sender delta differs from the requested amount is rejected and reverted
decimals are validated at acceptance time and never assumed beyond the [0, 18] bound
allowance races are mitigated by requiring exact-amount approvals and consuming them within the same transaction
recovery paths revert to the last known-good accounting state without accepting funds from an unsupported asset
supportedTokenBehavior.unsupportedAssetPolicy: fail before funds are accepted; no partial acceptance or silent coercion is permitted
requiredTests: erc777-like hook rejection and re-entrancy guard
decimals extremes rejection and overflow guard
append between pages returns each evidence item exactly once
duplicate CID append is idempotent and surfaces DuplicateEvidenceCID on conflict
invalid limit below minLimit or above maxLimit returns InvalidPageLimit
finalized claim cannot be appended to and historical pages remain identical
reorg fixture preserves cursor binding and lawful removal semantics
full traversal returns each evidence item exactly once across concurrent appends
nonGoals: applying Stellar Wave before maintainer activation
